verses.en: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Israel.
verses.pt: Jeosafá, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar, e fortaleceu-se contra Israel.
verses.en_web: Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place, and strengthened himself against Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And Jehoshaphat his son became king in his place, and made himself strong against Israel.

verses.en: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
verses.pt: Pôs forças armadas em todas as cidades fortes de Judá e dispôs guarnições na terra de Judá, como também nas cidades de Efraim que Asa, seu pai, tinha tomado.
verses.en_web: He placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
verses.en_bbe: He put forces in all the walled towns of Judah, and responsible chiefs in the land of Judah and in the towns of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

verses.en: And the LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not unto Baalim;
verses.pt: E o Senhor era com Jeosafá, porque andou conforme os primeiros caminhos de Davi, seu pai, e não buscou aos baalins;
verses.en_web: Yahweh was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and didn’t seek the Baals,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord was with Jehoshaphat, because he went in the early ways of his father, not turning to the Baals,

verses.en: But sought to the LORD God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.
verses.pt: antes buscou ao Deus de seu pai, e andou nos seus mandamentos, e não segundo as obras de Israel.
verses.en_web: but sought to the God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not in the ways of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: But turning to the God of his father and keeping his laws, and not doing as Israel did.

verses.en: Therefore the LORD stablished the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents; and he had riches and honour in abundance.
verses.pt: Por isso o Senhor confirmou o reino na sua mão; e todo o Judá trouxe presentes a Jeosafá; e ele teve riquezas e glória em abundância.
verses.en_web: Therefore Yahweh established the kingdom in his hand. All Judah brought tribute to Jehoshaphat, and he had riches and honor in abundance.
verses.en_bbe: So the Lord made his kingdom strong; and all Judah gave offerings to Jehoshaphat, and he had great wealth and honour.

verses.en: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah.
verses.pt: E encorajou-se o seu coração nos caminhos do Senhor; e ele tirou de Judá os altos e os aserins.
verses.en_web: His heart was lifted up in the ways of Yahweh. Furthermore, he took away the high places and the Asherah poles out of Judah.
verses.en_bbe: His heart was lifted up in the ways of the Lord; and he went so far as to take away the high places and the wood pillars out of Judah.

verses.en: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes, even to Ben-hail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.
verses.pt: No terceiro ano do seu reinado enviou ele os seus príncipes, Bene-Hail, Obadias, Zacarias, Netanel e Micaías, para ensinarem nas cidades de Judá;
verses.en_web: Also in the third year of his reign he sent his princes, even Ben Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah;
verses.en_bbe: In the third year of his rule he sent Benhail and Obadiah and Zechariah and Nethanel and Micaiah, his captains, as teachers into the towns of Judah;

verses.en: And with them he sent Levites, even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tob-adonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, priests.
verses.pt: e com eles os levitas Semaías, Netanias, Zebadias, Asael, Semiramote, Jônatas, Adonias, Tobias e Tobadonias e, com estes levitas, os sacerdotes Elisama e Jeorão.
verses.en_web: and with them the Levites, even Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, the Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.
verses.en_bbe: And with them, Shemaiah and Nethaniah and Zebadiah and Asahel and Shemiramoth and Jehonathan and Adonijah and Tobijah and Tob-adonijah, the Levites; and Elishama and Jehoram the priests.

verses.en: And they taught in Judah, and had the book of the law of the LORD with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people.
verses.pt: E ensinaram em Judá, levando consigo o livro da lei do Senhor; foram por todas as cidades de Judá, ensinando entre o povo.
verses.en_web: They taught in Judah, having the book of Yahweh’s law with them. They went about throughout all the cities of Judah and taught among the people.
verses.en_bbe: And they gave teaching in Judah and had the book of the law of the Lord with them; they went through all the towns of Judah teaching the people.

verses.en: And the fear of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
verses.pt: Então caiu o temor do Senhor sobre todos os reinos das terras que estavam ao redor de Judá, de modo que não fizeram guerra contra Jeosafá.
verses.en_web: The fear of Yahweh fell on all the kingdoms of the lands that were around Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
verses.en_bbe: And the fear of the Lord was on all the kingdoms of the lands round Judah, so that they made no wars against Jehoshaphat.

verses.en: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and tribute silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats.
verses.pt: Alguns dentre os filisteus traziam presentes a Jeosafá, e prata como tributo; e os árabes lhe trouxeram rebanhos: sete mil e setecentos carneiros, e sete mil e setecentos bodes.
verses.en_web: Some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents and silver for tribute. The Arabians also brought him flocks, seven thousand seven hundred rams, and seven thousand seven hundred male goats.
verses.en_bbe: And some of the Philistines took offerings to Jehoshaphat, and made him payments of silver; and the Arabians gave him flocks, seven thousand, seven hundred sheep, and seven thousand, seven hundred he-goats.

verses.en: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Judah castles, and cities of store.
verses.pt: Assim Jeosafá ia-se tornando cada vez mais poderoso; e edificou fortalezas e cidades-armazéns em Judá;
verses.en_web: Jehoshaphat grew great exceedingly; and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah.
verses.en_bbe: Jehoshaphat became greater and greater, and made strong towers and store-towns in Judah.

verses.en: And he had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, were in Jerusalem.
verses.pt: e teve grande quantidade de munições nas cidades de Judá, e soldados, homens valorosos, em Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: He had many works in the cities of Judah; and men of war, mighty men of valor, in Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: He had much property in the towns of Judah; he had forces of armed men, great and strong, in Jerusalem.

verses.en: And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Judah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.
verses.pt: Este é o número deles segundo as suas casas paternas: de Judá os comandantes de mil: o comandante Adná, com trezentos mil homens valorosos;
verses.en_web: This was the numbering of them according to their fathers’ houses: From Judah, the captains of thousands: Adnah the captain, and with him three hundred thousand mighty men of valor;
verses.en_bbe: This is the number of them, listed by their families, the captains of thousands of Judah: Adnah, the captain, and with him three hundred thousand men of war;

verses.en: And next to him was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand.
verses.pt: após ele o comandante Jeoanã com duzentos e oitenta mil;
verses.en_web: and next to him Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred eighty thousand;
verses.en_bbe: Second to him Jehohanan, the captain, and with him two hundred and eighty thousand;

verses.en: And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto the LORD; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.
verses.pt: após ele Amasias, filho de Zicri, que voluntariamente se entregou ao Senhor, e com ele duzentos mil valorosos;
verses.en_web: and next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself to Yahweh, and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valor.
verses.en_bbe: After him Amasiah, the son of Zichri, who freely gave himself to the Lord, and with him two hundred thousand men of war;

verses.en: And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.
verses.pt: e de Benjamim: Eliadá, homem destemido, com duzentos mil armados de arco e de escudo;
verses.en_web: From Benjamin: Eliada, a mighty man of valor, and with him two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield;
verses.en_bbe: And the captains of Benjamin: Eliada, a great man of war, and with him two hundred thousand armed with bows and body-covers;

verses.en: And next him was Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war.
verses.pt: e após ele Jeozabade, com cento e oitenta mil armados para a guerra.
verses.en_web: and next to him Jehozabad, and with him one hundred eighty thousand ready and prepared for war.
verses.en_bbe: And after him Jehozabad, and with him a hundred and eighty thousand trained for war.

verses.en: These waited on the king, beside those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Judah.
verses.pt: Estes estavam no serviço do rei, afora os que o rei tinha posto nas cidades fortes por todo o Judá.
verses.en_web: These were those who waited on the king, besides those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.
verses.en_bbe: These were the men who were waiting on the king, in addition to those placed by the king in the walled towns through all Judah.
